question: Pointing to a girl, Aryan said, "She is the daughter of the only child of my grandmother." How is the girl related to Aryan?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

“She is the daughter of the only child of my grandmother.”

Aryan’s grandmother has only one child.
That child must be Aryan’s **parent** (either father or mother).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62d7ca0bb1320803a109a63eac812e149d50c48bad099fda44b380bad60c2c0d.png] 

Therefore, the girl is Aryan’s **Sister**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
